name: EVALI

VINIT.justification: The unperturbed physiological baseline before the introduction of aerosolized agents.

TANCH.justification: The terminal boundary of the acute injury phase where the system either stabilizes or ceases function.

AFWD.justification: The directed transport of the external chemical agent into the deep lung architecture.

AREV.justification: The inability to expel the irritant, leading to a descent into pathological accumulation.

CLINK.justification: The sequential binding of the exogenous lipid to the endogenous surfactant layer.

IMSCRIB.justification: The self-recognition of the lung tissue as the site of systemic interface and injury.

FSPLIT.justification: The branching of Vitamin E acetate into inert vapor and highly reactive ketene gas.

FFUSE.justification: The reconstitution of the chemical insult into a singular inflammatory signal within the host.

EVALT.justification: The affirmative activation of the immune system in response to chemical injury.

EVALF.justification: The failure of the lung's mechanical surface tension regulation.

ENGAGR.justification: The simultaneous presence of chemical insult and host immune response held in a state of acute pathology.

IFIX.justification: The permanent, irreversible chemical modification and fixation of the lung tissue.

phase_3.void_description: Clear airway before the first inhalation of the aerosolized agent.
phase_3.true_description: Active recruitment of neutrophils and macrophages to the site of injury.
phase_3.false_description: Loss of alveolar structural integrity and gas exchange capability.
phase_3.both_description: The EVALI syndrome where the lung is both a site of active defense and passive destruction.

steps.domain_action: Establish the baseline physiological state of the pulmonary system.
Identify the alveolar-capillary interface as the primary operational site.
Introduce the aerosolized Vitamin E acetate into the bronchial tree.
Link the aerosol particles to the moisture-rich environment of the lower respiratory tract.
Apply heat to the acetate, branching the substance into inert components and reactive ketene.
Trigger the affirmative inflammatory cascade in response to the ketene electrophile.
Record the failure of the surfactant layer to maintain alveolar patency.
Hold the paradox of the lung as both a functional organ and a site of chemical fixation.
Recombine the chemical and biological signals into a unified clinical diagnosis.
Observe the failure of natural clearance mechanisms to reverse the chemical deposition.
Commit the chemical modification of the tissue to a permanent pathological record.
Close the system at the point of clinical intervention or respiratory arrest.

phase_5.compiler_frontend: The heating element of the e-cigarette device translating liquid into reactive vapor.
phase_5.ipc_mechanism: Cytokine signaling between damaged epithelial cells and circulating immune cells.
phase_5.memory_mechanism: The accumulation of lipid-laden macrophages within the alveolar spaces.
phase_5.scheduler_mechanism: The kinetic rate of thermal degradation versus the rate of tidal ventilation.
phase_5.alfs_store: The CDC clinical case definition for EVALI diagnosis.

phase_6.cycle_cost: Thermal energy required for the degradation of Vitamin E acetate.
phase_6.post_cycle_state: Pathological state of acute lung injury.
phase_6.delta_s_verdict: ΔS ≈ 0 — The system undergoes a phase transition where chemical energy is converted into structural fixation.
